m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Revered Mother forewarned us that you might seek entry into the Monastery without invitation. Your transgression must be punished.
Talk about a transgression. I can't believe all the Sisters have to wear the same drab, blue robes. I almost feel sorry for them.
And you really think they're all sisters? That would be one big litter... hm. Either way, we're here for the Mother. Lead the way, Master.
Your assistance in securing the lordship for Atraydies was much appreciated, Wizard, but we need your help no longer, and you are not welcome.
The Revered Mother sent me to formally inform you of this fact, and forcibly remove you from the premises. You will not get by me.
I never liked her. When you were gone with Pol, she was gossiping in the Manor. I usually enjoy a little gossip, but not like that.
Reverend Mother this, Reverend Mother that... so repetitive. I think she was afraid of her. To be honest, I am too. Master, you can go first.
Ah. It seems Sister Iroolan failed in her duties. She will have to atone for that. There will be no atonement for your transgressions, however.
I was worried you might catch on to the enchantment placed on Pol. The Binny Jezzerit are destined to govern House Tabbi, and this is our way.
Unfortunately for you, it must remain a secret for now, which means you know too much. Come, Wizard, I will try to make this quick and painless.
Stand down, Outsider. You've made your point. I will relinquish my control over Pol Atraydies.
This will remove the enchantment that bound him. We must simply trust that henceforth, good breeding will ensure Atraydies makes wise decisions.
There. It is done. Return to the Manor and you will find he is now free of my influence. I just hope we never come to regret this.
There you are! I was worried you left. I feel... better now. I think this is the dawn of a new day and perhaps even a new era for House Tabbi.
Despite your stubbornness, your... loyalty to House Tabbi is doubtless. I think clemency is in order, allowing you to remain a House Retainer.
But this decision belongs to our new lord, doesn't it? Pol Atraydies. I believe exile is the proper punishment, don't you?
Yes, Revered Mother. Exile is the proper punishment. Count Crowl you are hereby banished from the Agouti Rift - you may never return.
If this is the way things are going to be, then I welcome such punishment. Goodbye to you all. You will not see me again.
With that ugly business behind us, I can say that everything has concluded just as it should. I must return to the Monastery. Good day.
That was... strange. Such great sympathy I felt for the Count, but act on it, I could not. I think I should... rest. Yes. I'll see you all later.
Well, I hate to say it, but the Count was right. The Reverend Mother can clearly control Pol when she wants. Master, we have to do something.
Yes... that did seem strange, and the Binny Jezzerit are known to employ such magics. You should go and discuss this with the Revered Mother... yes.
Er... what was it you needed? Oh yes, the Revered Mother. Go speak to her and make sure that she's not using her magics to control young Pol.
